pattern: かと思いきや（かとおもいきや）
purpose: Reveal that an outcome contradicts an initial expectation.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain clause + かと思いきや
I thought it had closed, but it was being renovated.
Just when I thought the cat was asleep, it suddenly ran off.
We expected an easy win, but it became a close match.
formation: Plain clause + かと思いきや
restrictions: The first clause sets up what seemed likely.
mistake: The second clause must overturn or sharply redirect that expectation.
